UP D.El.Ed Admit Card 2026 - Direct Link to Check Status Online at btcexam.in - Complete Details

UP D.El.Ed admit card 2026 will be released soon for 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th semester. Find where to download the hall ticket, step-by-step download process, exam form dates and what is still unconfirmed.

Important Dates

  • Exam name : UP D.El.Ed (also called UP BTC) semester examination 2026
  • Admit card mode : Online download from the official portal
  • Exam form window (1st and 3rd semester) : 19 August 2026 to 30 August 2026

Application Fee

  • Exam form, 1st and 3rd semester (last date) : 30 August 2026

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
